description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience driving product direction, go-to-market strategy, and design with data-driven decisions.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in a technology or business related field.
* Experience launching successful app products in the market.
* Experience with complex product/outbound customer work, and developing products with an understanding of current cloud technologies and services.
* Knowledge of market, landscape, and customer/user requirements in-depth.
* Ability to collaborate, solve ambiguous problems, and think innovatively.
* Excellent communication, technical, and organizational skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The mission of the Google Workspace team is to deliver flexible, innovative solutions for people and organizations to achieve more. As a Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and set product priorities. You will partner closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to define and deliver on cloud services.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the product direction and strategy for product areas within Google Workspace.
* Design and lead the product roadmap by managing goals and investments to scale globally.
* Engage with customers to understand their strategies, end-to-end business processes, pain points, and priorities to inform product strategy and provide transparency into roadmaps/managing expectations.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX, and other internal Google teams to drive product and delivery success. Analyze landscape and industry trends to advance our products and drive innovation.
* Foster and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders, delivery partners, and operational teams. Attract, develop, and retain an excellent team of product managers.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by leading a high-visibility modernization that reshapes how teams access trusted insights at scale. You will drive a firmwide legacy analytics decommission and migration, partnering with senior leaders and global delivery teams to deliver measurable outcomes by a strategic deadline. Join a team that values ownership, career mobility, and hands-on impact across a complex technology transformation.

As a Product Manager at JPMorganChase within Commercial & Investment Banking unit, you will lead end-to-end delivery of a legacy business intelligence platform decommission and migration to modern cloud-native analytics tools. You will own inventory analysis, migration planning, and cross-functional execution to move thousands of reports, schedules, and users to approved replacement capabilities. You will partner with technology, data, and business stakeholders to prioritize migration waves, reduce scope through rationalization, and ensure continuity for critical reporting. You will provide transparent governance and executive communications to ensure delivery against a firm strategic deadline.

This role sits within a senior leadership-sponsored transformation program and focuses on retiring legacy reporting capabilities while enabling scalable, modern analytics. You will coordinate across multiple geographies and functions to align business priorities, data dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Success in this role requires strong product ownership, structured program governance, and the ability to translate complex reporting and data flows into actionable migration plans. You will balance speed of delivery with risk awareness, ensuring that regulated or controlled reporting obligations remain continuously supported.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve a comprehensive inventory of reports, schedules, and data extract processes, driving rationalization and recertification to reduce migration scope and risk.
* Map report logic and data flows to business processes, application integrations, and downstream dependencies, prioritizing migration waves based on criticality and complexity.
* Lead stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions, facilitating workshops to document current usage, capture requirements, and define future-state reporting needs.
* Define functional and non-functional requirements for replacement reporting capabilities, including scheduling, distribution, embedded analytics, and integration needs.
* Drive evaluation and selection of replacement tools by coordinating structured demos, proof-of-concept activities, and decision forums aligned to program objectives and constraints.
* Oversee migration planning and execution across data warehouse, data pipelines (extract, transform, load), and reporting layers, ensuring source-to-target mapping and semantic definitions are maintained.
* Leverage analytics and approved automation approaches (including responsible use of artificial intelligence-enabled tooling) to accelerate usage analysis, pattern detection, and migration prioritization while maintaining appropriate risk awareness.
* Produce clear program governance artifacts (status reporting, risks/issues/dependencies, milestone tracking, and escalation materials) for senior technology and business leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery across a global team, proactively surfacing blockers, managing competing priorities, and driving timely decisions.
* Deliver change management activities including user communications, training coordination for new platforms, adoption tracking, and transition support through cutover.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Proven experience as a technical product manager or senior business analyst delivering large-scale technology decommission, data migration, or reporting transformation programs in financial services.
* Demonstrated knowledge of enterprise reporting landscapes, including report lifecycle management, self-service reporting, automated scheduling/distribution, embedded analytics, and integration with data pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise reporting or analytics platform (for example: Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Microsoft Power BI, MicroStrategy, Sigma, Cognos, SAP BusinessObjects, or similar).
* Experience analyzing, rationalizing, and migrating large report inventories, including prioritization, wave planning, and execution tracking.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts (for example: dimensional modeling, facts and dimensions, and data marts) sufficient to assess migration impacts and dependencies.
* Working knowledge of data integration patterns and pipeline scheduling sufficient to document data flows and coordinate re-platforming activities with engineering teams.
* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL), including complex joins and reconciliations used to validate migration completeness and data quality.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience facilitating workshops, aligning cross-functional priorities, and driving decisions across senior audiences.
* Program governance capability, including structured planning, milestone management, dependency management, and executive-ready communications.
* Awareness of regulated, controlled, or audit-relevant reporting considerations and the need to maintain continuity during platform transitions.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Hands-on experience with SAP BusinessObjects and/or Crystal Reports (for example: Web Intelligence, scheduling, universe design, or report development).
* Experience building dashboards or reports in modern analytics tools (for example: calculations, parameters, filters, and visualization best practices).
* Experience using analytics automation or artificial intelligence-enabled tools (e.g. Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex, ChatGPT/Copilot) to accelerate dataset analysis or workflow efficiency in a controlled enterprise environment.
* Experience with cloud-native data platforms (for example: Snowflake, Databricks, or Google BigQuery) and how reporting tools connect to cloud query engines.
* Experience with SQL performance tuning, data profiling, anomaly detection, and end-to-end data quality validation.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing across distributed user groups and supporting structured change management.
* Experience engaging vendors and running structured evaluations, proofs of concept, or request-for-information/request-for-proposal processes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Risk
description:
**About Tala**

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

### **The Role**

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

### **What You'll Do**

### **Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy**

* Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
* Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
* Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

### **Build Data-Driven Fraud Products**

* Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
* Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
* Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
* Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
* Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

### **Lead Product Execution**

* Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
* Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
* Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
* Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

### **Manage Fraud & Risk Events**

* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
* Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
* Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

### **Collaborate Across Tala**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
* Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
* Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

### **What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
* Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
* Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
* Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
* Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**About NationsBenefits:**

At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core backoffice functions in the insurance domain.

The ideal candidate brings deep analytical rigor, unwavering attention to detail, and a relentless commitment to product quality and accuracy. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can navigate complex, interconnected systems — fee schedules, provider networks, plan configurations, and claims processing — while maintaining the trust of hundreds of clients who depend on flawless execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable product specifications.

**Quality & Accuracy Focus**

* Proactively identify data integrity issues, configuration errors, and process gaps before they impact clients

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce errors, increase automation, and enhance system reliability

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary product liaison between engineering, operations, client services, and leadership

* Communicate product updates, risks, and roadmap changes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Partner with client-facing teams to understand pain points and translate feedback into product enhancements

* Collaborate with QA to define testing protocols that ensure system accuracy at scale.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Support hundreds of client configurations, ensuring the platform scales without sacrificing accuracy.

* Address escalations related to fee schedules, network mapping, or claims discrepancies with urgency and precision.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare, benefits administration, or insurance technology.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-component systems or platforms.

* Working knowledge of database systems, with ability to write moderately complex SQL queries.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data driven decisions.

* Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in high-stakes, accuracy-critical environments.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for varied audiences.

* Experience with claims processing systems, provider network data, or fee schedule management strongly preferred.

* Proven track record managing products that serve a large, diverse client base.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (MBA a plus).

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead a pioneering FinTech initiative with cutting-edge technologies and scalable architecture.

* Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing, innovative-driven environment.

* Impact the financial ecosystem by building secure, high-performance applications.

* Contribute to cutting-edge products that enhance member engagement in healthcare.

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. **Join the team!**  

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Understand the games inside out.** Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* **Start with a hypothesis.** Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* **Run experiments that decide.** Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* **Connect growth and product.** Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* **Grow the product craft.** Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* **Spot tomorrow’s hits.** Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

### **What You’ll Own:**

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!

* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. **About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Product Manager** to guide how changes are planned and implemented on our backend-heavy fintech platform, built on Java, Spring Boot, Groovy and microservices, with MongoDB and a Vue.js frontend. In this role, you will be the central review point for platform changes, working with engineering, QA and business teams so that each change is well analysed, well designed and documented before development begins.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Use Case Analysis:** Work with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, define use cases and user flows, and confirm expected behaviour before work is taken up.
* **Edge Case Identification:** Identify edge cases, exception scenarios and failure conditions for each change, and make sure they are covered in the design and test plans.
* **Product Design with Technical Analysis:** Translate requirements into product designs supported by technical analysis, covering service placement, API contracts, data model changes and integration points.
* **Change Review & Implementation Approach:** Review change requests, assess their impact across microservices, APIs, MongoDB collections and downstream consumers, and agree on the implementation approach with engineering.
* **Data & Configuration Changes:** Guide changes to MongoDB document structures, indexes and data migrations, as well as Groovy-based scripts and configurations, with attention to backward compatibility.
* **Documentation & Traceability:** Maintain clear records linking requirements, design decisions, code changes and releases, including release and rollback plans for each change.
* **Compliance:** Help ensure product features and technical changes follow applicable financial regulations and standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, SOC2) and support audit needs.
* **Agile Delivery:** Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming and retrospectives, with epics and user stories that include clear acceptance criteria and technical detail.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the technical point of contact between engineering, QA, compliance and business teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Overall Experience:** 10+ years in Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management or Software Engineering, including at least 4–5 years of hands-on backend development or technical leadership in Java and Spring Boot.
* **Industry Experience:** At least 5 years in a fintech organisation (e.g., payments, banking technology, wealth management, lending).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field.
* **Technical Skills:** Good understanding of microservices architecture, including service boundaries, inter-service communication and API contract management; practical experience with MongoDB data modelling, indexing and production data changes; working knowledge of Groovy; familiarity with Vue.js to assess the frontend impact of backend changes.
* **Analytical Skills:** Experience in use case analysis, edge case identification and writing functional and technical specifications.
* **Tools:** Experience with Confluence, Jira and Swagger/Open API, and the ability to read and review code, design documents and API specifications.
* **Communication:** Ability to explain technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience moving teams from legacy systems to modern cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with compliance audits and building features for regulatory reporting.

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Selection Monitoring
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. We build state-of-the-art information retrieval infrastructure, extracting structured-data from unstructured-content, automatic item classification, storage systems to hold the massive catalog and distributed systems of cloud-scale. We apply parallel processing, Generative AI solutions, and machine learning algorithms to evaluate millions of products every day and to identify and prioritize new additions to Amazon’s selection efficiently. If you are customer obsessed, driven, tenacious and analytical, you will have fun solving our business problems of unprecedented scale. You will develop deep technical expertise and learn designing large scale distributed, service-oriented systems. Come join us in our journey to improve our customer experience at Amazon !  
  
Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful consumer products, have demonstrated the ability to lead high-performance teams, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, and software development processes (especially agile). You should be highly analytical, able to work effectively across teams, and thrive in entrepreneurial, fast-paced work environments.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead product strategy and vision supported by internal data and external analysis.
* Define creative, high quality, simple product requirements and roadmaps based on product strategy.
* Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance and operational support requirements.
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key partners
* Work closely with engineering teams to deliver products to market using agile development methodologies.
* Stay current and report on industry trends, including new opportunities, competitor capabilities, etc.
* Measure and analyze existing products and business models for opportunities to innovate and improve, providing additional benefits to developers and customers
* Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals

  
About the team  
Amazon carries the world’s largest catalog of products and in order to maintain this lead, we are constantly exploring and understanding the global e-commerce landscape. The mission of Selection Monitoring (SM) team is to collect all publicly available facts and generate insights about brands and products. SM is a global team with the charter to enable World Product Catalog (WPC) and surface these facts and insights to WW Amazon teams where we have an e-commerce business. SM’s primary objective is to improve Amazon selection and customer experience by discovering, validating, prioritizing off-Amazon brands and selection.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

* Experience in Agile delivery models and iterative development

* Strong understanding of technology architectures, APIs, and platforms

* Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills

* Team-first mindset with willingness to roll up sleeves

* Background in platform product management

* Experience managing executive communications or business presentations

* Defining product vision, strategy, and roadmap

* Driving discovery, prioritization, development, rollout, and adoption

* Translating user needs into technical requirements with Engineering

* Collaborating with business stakeholders to define priorities and success metrics

* Optimizing user journeys and platform health across CP&I tools and services

* Driving consistency in product quality, documentation, KPIs, and roadmap communication

**Department:** Product & Technology

**About the Role**

Hawk Martech is looking for an experienced **Product Manager – CPaaS** to drive the development and growth of communication and customer-engagement products.

The ideal candidate should have **hands-on product management experience in CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service)** and a strong understanding of communication channels such as **SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email, and communication APIs**.

We are specifically looking for someone who has worked with **CPaaS, communication platforms, messaging platforms, cloud telephony, conversational communication, or API-based communication products** and understands the technical and commercial aspects of these products.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the **product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution** for CPaaS and communication products.
* Identify market opportunities and customer problems across messaging, voice, and communication channels.
* Define product priorities based on customer requirements, market trends, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Work closely with leadership to define product growth and expansion strategies.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle from **discovery to development, launch, and optimization**.

CPaaS Product Management

* Drive products and features across **SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, Email, and other communication channels**.
* Understand communication APIs, messaging workflows, delivery mechanisms, templates, routing, authentication, and third-party integrations.
* Work on **omnichannel communication and customer engagement** use cases.
* Understand and manage integrations with telecom operators, messaging providers, communication platforms, and other third-party APIs.
* Identify opportunities to improve message delivery, reliability, scalability, customer experience, and platform adoption.
* Work with technical teams on APIs, webhooks, SDKs, integrations, dashboards, reporting, and automation workflows.

Product Discovery & Market Research

* Conduct customer interviews and gather requirements from enterprise customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Research competitors and market developments across the **CPaaS, messaging, cloud communication, and customer engagement** ecosystem.
* Analyze platforms and solutions offered by companies such as **Tanla Platforms, Route Mobile, Gupshup, Exotel, Tata Communications, Airtel IQ, Netcore, Twilio, Plivo, Sinch, Infobip, Bird, Vonage, and similar communication platforms**.
* Identify gaps in existing solutions and convert them into actionable product opportunities.
* Stay updated with developments in **WhatsApp Business, RCS, SMS, Voice APIs, cloud telephony, conversational AI, and communication technology**.

Product Development

* Create detailed **PRDs, user stories, product specifications, workflows, and acceptance criteria**.
* Work closely with engineering, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, and business teams.
* Translate customer and business requirements into clear technical and functional requirements.
* Prioritize features and manage scope, dependencies, timelines, and releases.
* Participate in product testing, UAT, release planning, and post-launch reviews.
* Ensure products are scalable, reliable, secure, and easy to use.

API & Technical Product Management

* Work closely with engineering teams on **REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, third-party integrations, and event-driven workflows**.
* Understand API documentation, authentication, request/response structures, error handling, and integration dependencies.
* Work with technical teams to define API requirements and integration experiences.
* Ensure seamless integration between CPaaS products and customer systems such as **CRM, marketing automation, e-commerce, and customer-support platforms**.
* A strong understanding of technical architecture and API-based products is required.

Compliance & Telecom Ecosystem

* Stay updated with relevant communication and messaging regulations, policies, and industry requirements.
* Understand areas such as **DLT, TRAI regulations, sender IDs, templates, consent, messaging policies, and delivery compliance**.
* Track changes in WhatsApp Business policies, RCS ecosystem developments, telecom requirements, and other platform policies.
* Work with technical and business teams to ensure product changes are aligned with applicable requirements.

Analytics & Product Performance

* Define and monitor key product and business metrics.
* Track metrics such as:
* Message Delivery Rate
* Delivery Success Rate
* API Usage
* Message Volume
* Customer Activation
* Customer Retention
* Conversion Rate
* Revenue
* Usage & Adoption
* Cost per Message / Communication
* Use product analytics and customer data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Work with engineering teams to ensure appropriate product tracking and analytics are implemented.

Pricing & Commercial Strategy

* Work with leadership on **pricing, plans, usage-based pricing, channel pricing, and packaging**.
* Understand the commercial model of CPaaS products, including communication costs, vendor costs, margins, and usage-based billing.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and increasing product adoption.

description:
**About Glomo**
---------------

Glomo is the regulated infrastructure layer that financial platforms build on for cross-border money movement out of India. We hold the licences, the bank integrations, the compliance engine and the settlement rails, and run them behind our clients' own brands.

Brokers, wealth platforms, AMCs, exporters and other businesses use Glomo to onboard their customers, run KYC and compliance checks, move and settle funds across borders, and reconcile it all back into their own systems. Our products span LRS remittances, global investing, card issuance and treasury.

Glomo is regulated by IFSCA through its GIFT City entity. Compliance is part of the product, and every PM here treats it that way.

**The role**
------------

We are hiring an Associate Product Manager / Product Manager, reporting directly to the founders. Level depends on experience.

This is a business product role. At Glomo, PMs sell: you will be in the room with merchants from the first conversation, and you will be accountable for the deal as much as the spec. You are not a feature desk for the sales team. You understand the customer well enough to decide what we should build for them, and what we should not.

You will join sales calls and demos, bring what you learn back to the product team, help shape the roadmap with them, write specs for the features you own, ship them with engineering, and take merchants live.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Sell.** Run discovery and demos, map a merchant's needs onto Glomo's products, and work with sales to close.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Bring merchant feedback and market insight to the product team, and work with them to prioritise what we build.
* **Write and ship.** Turn merchant needs into clear PRDs and user flows for the features you own. Work with engineering and design through launch.
* **Take merchants live.** Drive integration and onboarding, and unblock issues across ops, compliance and the merchant's own team.
* **Track adoption.** Watch usage and conversion, find where users drop off, and fix it.
* **Work inside the rules.** Partner with compliance, legal and risk so products meet IFSCA and FEMA/LRS requirements from day one.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of work experience, including a client-facing sales role: account executive, inside sales, pre-sales or enterprise BD, preferably selling software or tech.
* MBA from a premier Indian business school.
* You can run a discovery call and a demo, handle objections, and manage a client relationship.
* Structured thinking and clear writing. You can turn a messy customer problem into a simple spec.
* Comfortable with data: Excel, and ideally basic SQL, to read a funnel and size an opportunity.
* You use AI tools effectively in your day-to-day work, for research, analysis, writing specs and prototyping, and you know where they fall short.
* Curious about how technical products work, and able to hold a conversation with engineers about APIs and integrations.
* You move fast, take ownership, and follow through without being chased.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience in financial services: banking, payments, fintech, broking, wealth management or mutual funds.
* Exposure to cross-border payments, or working knowledge of LRS, FEMA or KYC/AML.
* A product internship or prior product stint.
* Early-stage startup experience.
* An engineering undergraduate degree.

**Why Glomo**
-------------

* Work directly with the founders on a small team.
* Own real merchant relationships and real product outcomes from your first month.
* Build regulated cross-border infrastructure that brokers, AMCs and payment platforms run on.

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.  
As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.  
A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade-offs when data is incomplete.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.
* Evaluate technical proposals and participate in architecture discussions, understanding how technical choices influence customer outcomes and balancing feature delivery with long-term system health and scalability.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

  
About the team  
AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non-sort buildings, traditional sort and non-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT also owns and operates the FaaST WMS that runs in Vendor Flex buildings, India Mini-FCs (small footprint, manual buildings in IN), and select Seller Flex locations (3P Sellers who are Prime-enabled leveraging the FaaST WMS). AFT also owns the External Fulfillment Platform (EFP), which integrates 3P WMSes to the Amazon Supply Chain. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites, and owns labor planning and scheduling technology leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.  
  
AFT General Summary  
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
